# htmx v4 User Guide (Unofficial)

> Practical user guide, Hypermedia-Driven Application (HDA) architecture patterns, and feature reference for htmx v4.0.1.

## Overview

- [Overview](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/): Welcome to the comprehensive engineering guide for htmx v4.0.1—a ground-up modernization of the hypermedia-oriented JavaScript library that empowers any HTML…
- [1. Getting Started](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/01_getting_started.html): htmx v4.0.1 extends standard HTML so any element—not just and —can issue HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, QUERY) and swap server-rendered HTML…
- [2. Hypermedia Architecture](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/02_hypermedia_architecture.html): Designing a clean Hypermedia-Driven Application (HDA) in htmx v4.0.1 centers on three architectural mechanisms: explicit attribute inheritance (:inherited…
- [3. Requests & Triggers](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/03_requests_and_triggers.html): htmx v4.0.1 gives you declarative control over when a request fires (hx-trigger), what parameters and headers it carries (hx-include, hx-vals, hx-headers…
- [4. Targeting & Swapping](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/04_targeting_and_swapping.html): Once the server responds with an HTML fragment, htmx v4.0.1 determines where to place the content (hx-target using extended relative CSS selectors) and how…
- [5. Headers, Events & Status](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/05_headers_events_and_status.html): htmx v4.0.1 coordinates client-server hypermedia state through standardized HX-* HTTP headers, declarative status-code routing (hx-status:XXX), and a…
- [6. Extensions & Streaming](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/06_extensions_and_streaming.html): htmx v4.0.1 features a streamlined event-hook extension architecture (htmx.registerExtension) and ships 17 official extensions covering real-time HTML…
- [7. History, Caching & UX](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/07_history_caching_and_ux.html): htmx v4.0.1 provides progressive enhancement (hx-boost), clean browser history navigation (hx-push-url, hx-replace-url, hx-history-elt), opt-in…
- [8. Security, Testing & Debugging](https://htmx.drawlib.com/en/08_security_testing_and_debugging.html): Because htmx inserts server-rendered HTML directly into the active document, production Hypermedia-Driven Applications require strict trust boundaries…
